title: RoboARC: Physical Puzzles for Robotic Manipulation under Spatial Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2611.33390v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many hard manipulation tasks come down to a spatial constraint that only a few motions satisfy, such as passing a part through a gap barely wider than itself or separating two interlocked parts. These motions depend on the exact geometry of each scene, so demonstrations and skills recorded elsewhere rarely transfer. We therefore ask: when manipulation hinges on spatial constraints, can robots reason out the right motions? We introduce RoboARC, a benchmark of 90 tasks in six constraint types over rigid and soft materials, on three robots in MuJoCo. Every task is a frozen scene with a physics-based grader and a verified reference solution that replays bit-identically. Each task comes in a Privileged regime, with the full simulator state and resets, and a Standard regime with real-sensor inputs (camera images and proprioception) and a single attempt without resets. translated_title: RoboARC：空间约束下机器人操作的物理谜题
translated_abstract: 许多困难的操作任务归根结底源于一种只有少数动作才能满足的空间约束，例如将一个零件穿过仅比它稍宽的缝隙，或将两个互锁的零件分开。这些动作取决于每个场景的精确几何形状，因此在别处记录的演示和技能很少能够迁移。由此我们提出这样一个问题：当操作成败取决于空间约束时，机器人能否推理出正确的动作？我们推出了RoboARC，这是一个包含90个任务的基准测试，涵盖刚性与软体材料上的六种约束类型，并在MuJoCo中的三台机器人上实现。每个任务都是一个冻结的场景，配有基于物理的评分器和经验证可逐位一致重放的参考解决方案。每个任务提供两种模式：特权模式，提供完整的模拟器状态和重置功能；标准模式，仅使用真实传感器输入（相机图像和本体感觉）且只允许单次尝试、不可重置。我们评估了七个编程智能体和四个VLA策略，它们均未在该基准上训练过。
tldr: 提出了RoboARC基准，包含90个空间约束下的机器人操作物理谜题任务，用以评估编程智能体和VLA策略在面对依赖精确几何的空间约束时能否推理出正确动作。
en_tdlr: Introduces RoboARC, a benchmark of 90 physical puzzle tasks for robotic manipulation under spatial constraints, evaluating whether coding agents and VLA policies can reason out the correct motions when success hinges on exact scene geometry.
